stem.text: A student carries out a double-slit experiment using a laser emitting red light of wavelength of $680\,\text{nm}$. The light is incident normally on a double slit.
The diagram shows part of the pattern of bright fringes visible on a screen at a distance of $2.4\,\text{m}$ from the slits. The distance across five bright fringes is measured as $34\,\text{mm}$.

stem.alt: Row of seven dark oval bright fringes, with a double-headed arrow above five of them labelled 34 mm.
